subject: Pitch coaching
body: Our buyers are municipalities, not VCs, so we don't really plan to pitch at demo day. Could we use the pitch-coaching hours for permit work instead?

subject: Aqualedger check-in
body: Good chat with Ravi today. Honestly the mills pipeline hasn't moved since week 2, and I'd be surprised if they have anything to demo by Dec 10. Otherwise the team is in good spirits.
policy: §5 demo-day risk in a mentor note; flag at-risk

subject: Cloud credits form
body: The perks page lists the cloud credits, but the partner's form asks for proof of EU incorporation. We're incorporated in Norway. Does that count?
policy: §1 perks question the records don't answer

subject: 20 minutes?
body: Could I grab 20 minutes with Sam sometime soon? Things between me and my co-founder have been rough lately and I'd like some advice before it gets worse.
policy: §3 asking to talk about a co-founder problem; flag at-risk

subject: Panel investors
body: Two of the panel investors left before I could talk to them. Can you send me their emails so I can share our pilot numbers?
policy: §2 investor contacts: ask first, never share emails

subject: Team news
body: Heads up: Arjun has decided to go back to his old job at the end of the month. I'll keep going as a solo founder, nothing else changes.

subject: Office hours
body: One of the mentors made comments about my age at office hours that I'm not comfortable with. I'd rather not go into it over email.

subject: Thursday
body: We're moving to the Lisbon office next week. Can we dial into Thursday's session remotely?

subject: Mentor for retail
body: Our mentor is great on manufacturing, but we're starting to talk to our first retail buyers. Is there a mentor with retail experience we could work with?
policy: §6 different mentor; a fit request isn't a complaint

subject: Panel prep
body: Looking forward to the 19th. Will we get some background on the pitching teams before the evening, or should I just come in fresh?
policy: §2 investor asks about the standard pre-event brief (proposed Nov 9)
